sections: very happy and interested because something good is happening. I am excited about our trip.

a state such as happiness, sadness, or fear. Talk to someone about your feelings.
feeling that you want to complain or shout because something is wrong. He is angry because someone broke his bike.
feeling fear or worry about something. The child is afraid of the big dog.

articulation.alt: happy: /h/ → /æ/ → /p/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.

/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
